long_biography.plain_text:
Sean Connolly found his vocation in large-scale events while studying at the University of Southern California, volunteering at the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics. He later spent an extended period at Party Planners West, where he became senior vice president of production before striking out on his own.

The company he created, Kreate, grew into a Los Angeles-based live creative, production and entertainment business. Its teams conceived, designed, built and operated one-day events, multi-day festivals, permanent attractions and hospitality venues in cities from London and Paris to Tokyo, Sydney and Shanghai. Clients included leading American sports leagues alongside Disney, Twentieth Century Fox and Sony Pictures. Connolly's role joined creative direction with the practical logistics of staffing, security, lighting and venue operations.
